release_input_scope.tool_version_evidence: AGP 9.1.0 embedded com/android/build/api/extension/impl/version.properties (baseVersion=32.1.0) and com/android/build/gradle/internal/res/aapt2_version.properties (aapt2Version=14792394). Linux AAPT2 is selected for the tagged hosted build; no tool is executed by this phase.
release_input_scope.excluded: Debug/beta/test-signer application variants and UTP/Jacoco test configurations are outside the tagged Android release tasks; their buildscript plugin inputs are still resolved.

installer_plan: Download this exact bounded archive; verify size and committed SHA-256 before extraction.
Reject links, special files and escaping paths; verify the included Cargo.lock against its committed SHA-256.
Use the separately pinned release Rust installer CARGO, RUSTC and RUSTDOC; do not use an unrelated PATH compiler.
Run CARGO install --path <verified-crate-directory> --locked --root <owned-tool-prefix> --jobs 2 with the existing compatible Cargo cache and an admitted finite build limit.
Require cargo-ndk --version to report 4.1.2; keep the archive and lock checksums with the build receipt. This records a local helper build, not a reproduced upstream binary.

sdk_status: Pinned SHA-256: complete archives streamed once and matched the reviewed official SHA-1 and exact size; no archive was retained, parsed or executed during pin acquisition.
dependency_metadata_status: Reviewed checksums are required before strict acquisition. Acquire writes dependency locks without changing checksums; a separate strict offline artifact replay must pass before release.

external_assumptions.host: Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 provides Python with tarfile.data_filter, its C/C++ compiler and linker, shell, Git and CA roots. CMake, DBus headers, pkg-config and its pkgconf/pkgconf-bin providers use the source-pinned noble APT snapshot. CMAKE=/usr/bin/cmake and PKG_CONFIG=/usr/bin/pkg-config bind the installed tools; exact package versions and executable probes are retained.
external_assumptions.jdk_correction: The accepted earlier workflow identified cached Temurin as 17.0.20+1, which has no matching official archive. The release now selects the official Temurin 17.0.20+8 archive and requires hosted qualification; prior binaries are not claimed to use this archive.
external_assumptions.qualification: Archive pins and source controls are verified. SDK extraction/layout, installed JDK execution, cargo-ndk compilation and the full Android release still require hosted qualification. No installer or compiler ran during pin preparation.
